title: convolvulus erinaceus var. kermanensis
intro: Convolvulus erinaceus var. kermanensis, commonly known as the Kerman bindweed, is a plant species that is native to Iran and is a variety of the Convolvulus erinaceus plant. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its ability to treat various ailments such as digestive issues and fever. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus erinaceus var. kermanensis include its ability to exhibit cardiotonic, diuretic, and spasmolytic effects, making it useful in treating conditions such as high blood pressure and muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
